result:
I’d make empathy unavoidable.

Not polite sympathy. Not “thoughts and prayers.” Actual, bone-deep recognition: every person would feel the reality of other people as clearly as they feel their own. Hunger, fear, humiliation, joy, grief—no longer abstractions.

Most cruelty depends on distance. Remove that, and the world would have to change.
